cards.title: Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants
cards.problem: Businesses need to keep systems, customer data and accounts protected as security risks evolve.
cards.solution: Review access controls, update software, maintain backups and create a clear incident-response process.

cards.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
cards.problem: Keeping up with technology changes can make it difficult to decide what deserves attention first.
cards.solution: Assess the business impact, validate the source and prioritize changes against measurable goals.

cards.problem: Businesses need to keep systems, customer data and accounts protected as security risks evolve.

cards.title: Reduce repetitive manual work
cards.problem: Teams spend too much time on repetitive tasks, leaving less time for customers and business growth.
cards.solution: Identify one recurring task and test a simple workflow using a form, spreadsheet or automation tool.

cards.title: Turn website visits into enquiries
cards.problem: Visitors may leave a business website without understanding what the company offers or how to make contact.
cards.solution: Make your services clear, add a visible enquiry button and ensure the contact form works well on mobile devices.
